quest.title: International Travel Log
quest.description: Midori from Inazuma City seems to be troubled by something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x5

dialogues.speaker: Midori
dialogues.text: Well, I'm running out of new stories to tell Kouichi...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of new story?

dialogues.speaker: Midori
dialogues.text: It's a new story told by Uncle Ramsay.

dialogues.speaker: Midori
dialogues.text: He said he's been to many countries and seen many interesting things. In order to record these things, he wrote something called the travelogue.

dialogues.speaker: Midori
dialogues.text: He showed me a lot of his travelogues!

dialogues.speaker: Midori
dialogues.text: For example, there's a kind of iron carriage that flies in the sky in Fontaine. It runs along an invisible road. It takes no time to travel from one end of the village to the other.

dialogues.speaker: Midori
dialogues.text: There's a special kind of grass in Sumeru, which can be planted anywhere. It can be planted in soil, water, or sand. Once it's planted, it will sprout and grow.

dialogues.speaker: Midori
dialogues.text: And... And... There's a kind of... hmmm... boat that can stay at the bottom of the sea for a long time!

dialogues.speaker: Midori
dialogues.text: By riding in that boat, people can go to the deep sea to do all kinds of things and see all kinds of fish!

response.speaker: Midori
response.text: Anyway, that's what Uncle Ramsay told me...

response.speaker: Midori
response.text: Well, that's not the point!

response.speaker: Midori
response.text: Recently, Uncle Ramsay stopped sending me his travelogue for some reason. So I'm running out of stories to tell Kouichi.

response.speaker: Midori
response.text: I know that Uncle Ramsay has been staying at the Komore Teahouse. I wanted to go find him. But the gatekeeper, Sister Kozue, wouldn't let me in because I'm a kid...

response.speaker: Midori
response.text: You look old enough. Can you help me ask Uncle Ramsay, what happened to those travelogues?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ehm, I am not that old...

response.speaker: Midori
response.text: Anyway! You look like a reliable person. Please help me!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll see.

response.speaker: Midori
response.text: Oh? Are you also interested in reading those travelogues? No problem. Just give them to me when you're finished.

response.speaker: Midori
response.text: I... I'll go with you. Although I can't get in, I can wait for you near the teahouse...

response.speaker: Midori
response.text: Ah, I'm so looking forward to reading Uncle Ramsay's new travelogue.

choices.text: Did he tell you about Snezhnaya?

response.speaker: Midori
response.text: Snezhnaya? Well, I don't think so.

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Komore Teahouse! How can I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Ramsay...

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: Oh that businessman... He is indeed in the teahouse. But he's been quite stressed recently. Not sure what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Kozue
dialogues.text: If you want to find him, just go inside and you'll see him.

talks.objective: Talk to Ramsay inside the teahouse

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Are you... a traveler? What can I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the travelogue...

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean the travelogue I wrote for that little girl Midori.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: I've been too busy to write those lately. She must be getting anxious...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are those travelogues real?

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Hahaha, what do you think?

choices.text: They don't sound real to me...

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: Hahaha, I can see you are well-traveled. You can tell right away.

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: That's right. Technically, none of the facts in the travelogues are real.

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: Although some places and characters are based on reality... Most of the contents are my own imagination.

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: Of course, some of it is not entirely imaginary. For example, in the travelogue that I'm writing, someone made a super balloon.

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: Then he summoned his friends and planned to travel around Teyvat in this balloon in 80 days.

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: Also, this balloon does not require a Vision to operate. All it takes is some technical knowledge.

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: These people travel around the world in the balloon, and they encounter various strange things and phenomena along the way...

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: I was going to write this for Midori. But for some reason, I didn't even have time to finish a short paragraph.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why is that?

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: Do you see that guy in the hallway? He's called Heihachi. He's been staring at me since I don't know when.

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: I was going out to look for inspiration for my travelogue. But that guy has been following me everywhere. I don't know what he's trying to do.

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: I'm worried that this guy has ill intentions towards me. I wouldn't dare to go out. That's why the travelogue has been delayed.

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: Fortunately, now you are here. Traveler, can you accompany me to look for inspiration outside? With you here, I don't think he would dare to do anything to me.

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: Thank you.

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: As the saying goes, "one must guard against others." Someone's staring at me from behind. I have to guard against him no matter what.

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: So when I'm looking for inspiration, please protect me, traveler.

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: In fact, I already have a few locations in mind. Let's go there right now.

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: The first place is near the beach. Let's go.

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: I don't know. But... People don't need a reason to be malicious to someone.

response.speaker: Ramsay
response.text: Hahaha, I also wish the things I wrote could come true.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: The water at this beach is crystal clear, and the color of the sand is so white, it's completely different from the open seas.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: It would be a nice place to set sail from... or take off from...

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Ehm, the scenery here is very nice. Let me write it down in my notes.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Traveler, please wait a moment. I need to think about how to write my travelogue. You can walk around and enjoy the scenery.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: But please don't stray too far away from me. The guy Heihachi is following me. He's just nearby.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: The water at this beach is crystal clear, and the color of the sand is so white, it's completely different from the open seas.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: This could be a safe place to set sail from...

dialogues.speaker: Heihachi
dialogues.text: Why are you standing in my way? Are you trying to start something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you following us?

dialogues.speaker: Heihachi
dialogues.text: Following you? What? I'm just taking a walk around here! What's wrong with that? Do you own this beach? Who do you think you are...

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Pretty good! The scenery here is really nice...

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: And then... Let me have a look. There is a river bend in the outskirts to the north of town. The small waterfall there is very nice. Let's go there.

talks.objective: Go to the waterfall north of the city

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: How come there are so many hilichurls here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There are more enemies in the distance.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Let's get out of here.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: I want to go to a higher place this time.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Well... What about the hill over there?

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: I want to go to a higher place this time.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Please take these paragraphs of travelogue to Midori. When I finish the whole story, I'll ask someone to bring her the completed travelogue.

dialogues.speaker: Heihachi
dialogues.text: Humph, there must be some sort of agenda behind it... Just that he hasn't exposed himself yet.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Why are there monsters wandering around... Although the scenery is very nice, it really is quite dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: But I can include this experience in my travelogue...

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Let's get out of here and find a safe place.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: That guy is still following us. He's really... humph... persistent...

talks.objective: Go to the summit of the nearby mountain

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Standing on the top of the mountain, you can almost see the entire Narukami Island.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: The wind at the mountain top is quite strong, and the height is perfect for take-off. There are no obstacles here.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: And it's a long way from Inazuma City, I won't be disturbed by Doushin... or by unwanted people.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It really is a good location.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: In conclusion, it's a good location to take off from... And it's a nice place to write about in the travelogue.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: That guy... he's still following us. He just won't let us go.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll get rid of him.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: It's fine. Don't worry about him. He wouldn't dare do anything rash with you around.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: When dealing with this kind of person... If you approach him, he would keep pestering you.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's call it a day. Let's go back to the Komore Teahouse.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: I already have some ideas about the main story of my travelogue. But it'll take me a day or two to finish the chapter.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: I wrote a few paragraphs before. Please take these paragraphs to Midori first.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: When I am finished with the whole story, I'll ask someone to bring her the completed travelogue.

dialogues.speaker: Heihachi
dialogues.text: Travelogue... Humph. That's what he says. How would I know if he has any other agendas...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Heihachi
dialogues.text: I said this guy has ulterior motives for writing these travelogues.

dialogues.speaker: Heihachi
dialogues.text: Who would think about such random nonsense? Traveling around Teyvat in a hot-air balloon without using a Vision...

dialogues.speaker: Heihachi
dialogues.text: Humph, there must be some sort of agenda behind it... he just hasn't exposed himself yet.

dialogues.speaker: Midori
dialogues.text: Traveler, did you get the Travelogue?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is from Mr. Ramsay...

dialogues.speaker: Midori
dialogues.text: Travel around Teyvat in Eighty Days... WOW! Thank you! Let me have a look...

dialogues.speaker: Midori
dialogues.text: Oh, how come this is so thin? The other travelogues are much thicker...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He hasn't finished yet.

dialogues.speaker: Midori
dialogues.text: Is that so? I'll wait and read it when Uncle Ramsay is finished... Then I'll have a new story to tell Kouichi.

dialogues.speaker: Midori
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler. These are for you. Please accept them.

dialogues.speaker: Heihachi
dialogues.text: What are you looking at?

dialogues.speaker: Heihachi
dialogues.text: Get out of my way!

dialogues.speaker: Heihachi
dialogues.text: What the hell is this place? There are monsters here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you following us?

dialogues.speaker: Heihachi
dialogues.text: Me... follow you? Aren't I allowed to come here to enjoy a walk and pick fruit? So paranoid...

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: The last location is the top of the hill over there.

dialogues.speaker: Ramsay
dialogues.text: The view there is very good. We should be able to get a panoramic view of the surrounding landscape.
